name: Lateral probe - final
description: Final lateral probe, covering the temporal lobe. Widened by 8 mm relative to iteration 2 to allow straight optic-fibre routing without reducing temporal-lobe coverage. Carries 4 EEG electrodes, 2 fNIRS sources, 2 fNIRS detectors, 1 fDCS source and 4 fDCS detectors.
